abilities_raw.name: Chrono Fracture
abilities_raw.description: You can briefly fracture time, slowing down your actions and those of nearby enemies for 3 seconds. This effect lasts 1 second per rank, up to a maximum of 10 seconds. Use this ability to dodge attacks or reposition during combat.
abilities_raw.cost: 10% of your stamina, plus 1 second of time distortion (you feel 1 second pass as 1.5 seconds).
abilities_raw.growth_math: XP_to_next = 40 * rank_index^1.55; rank 1: 3s, +1s/rank; soft cap at rank 8 (XP * 0.6); effect mult = 1.22^ranks_above_F; +1 domain check/rank; recharges 1h after rank 10

abilities_raw.name: Echo Surge
abilities_raw.description: Create a powerful shockwave that echoes through the environment, damaging enemies and knocking them back. The shockwave travels 10 meters per rank, up to a maximum of 50 meters. Use this to clear a path or disrupt formations.
abilities_raw.prerequisites: Unlocks after you teach someone the outline — and realize what you still lack.
abilities_raw.cost: A burst of energy equivalent to 10 seconds of your life force, plus a 5-minute cooldown.
abilities_raw.growth_math: XP_to_next = 50 * rank_index^1.58; rank 1: 10m, +5m/rank; soft cap at rank 7 (XP * 0.6); effect mult = 1.18^ranks_above_E; +1 domain check/rank; recharges 1d after rank 10

abilities_raw.name: Echoing Breath
abilities_raw.description: Summon a whispering wind that echoes your voice across surfaces, disorienting foes within 30 feet. Lasts 10 seconds per rank between uses.
abilities_raw.growth_math: Rank 1: 10 sec duration; Rank 2: 15 sec; Rank 3: 20 sec; XP: 50 per rank. Max rank 5 (30 sec).

abilities_raw.name: Accent Mirror
abilities_raw.description: You can slight local pronunciation mimic — comic at F. At F rank the effect is brief, incomplete, or easy to miss. With practice it may grow toward perfect persona mask — never as a free start.
abilities_raw.cost: A nosebleed or iron taste if pushed twice in a row
abilities_raw.growth_math: XP_to_next = 36 * rank_index^1.58 (F=1); use 5-11 XP × risk (1/2/3/4); soft cap after C ×0.55 until breakthrough; ladder F…S/SS/SSS; each rank +1 check / +14–22% effect

abilities_raw.name: Echo of the Mountain
abilities_raw.description: Duplicate your voice to create echoes that can confuse enemies or guide allies. Each echo lasts 5 seconds and can be directed in one direction. Cannot be used within 50 meters of a mountain or cliff.
abilities_raw.cost: 1 minute of focused breathing; cannot use within 10 seconds of last use
abilities_raw.growth_math: XP: 150 per rank; max rank 8. Each rank increases echo duration by 2 seconds and allows 1 additional echo per use.

abilities_raw.name: Gear Click
abilities_raw.description: You can hear when a simple mechanism is misaligned. It only answers cleanly when you have clockwork or latch nearby. At F rank the effect is brief, incomplete, or easy to miss. With practice it may grow toward machine communion — never as a free start.
abilities_raw.prerequisites: Unlocks after a night of focused practice with no audience and no shortcuts.
